Yang Industries possesses a firm, verified alternative opportunity providing $300,000 in standalone value. Given our critical manufacturing capacity and capital intensity in executing this venture, we request a fair allocation of $360,000, reflecting our baseline plus an equitable division of the generated surplus.

We estimate our alternative enterprise cloud contracts yield a baseline value of approximately $200,000. Given our vital role in operationalizing the technology, we are targeting an equitable allocation of $333,334 of the $1,000,000 total profit, ensuring all three partners share equally in the collaborative surplus.

The updated allocation is G-Corp: $475,000; Yang Industries: $320,000; Chang-Liu Cloud Services: $205,000.
